note: Sourced, dated facts of the US route for the 2027 intake: the app's own data, not in the design's SEED. Every fact carries the page it was read on and the day it was read. A page that could not be read is listed in not_read and nothing is written from it.

nyu.name: New York University
nyu.page: NYU 2026-2027 Bulletins, Tisch School of the Arts, Undergraduate Admissions
nyu.year_basis: The page gives the month and the day and names no year. It is the bulletin of 2026-2027, so an application filed under it is for entry in fall 2027: 1 November is 2026, 1 and 5 January are 2027.

deadlines.name: Early Decision I
deadlines.says: We urge you to complete and file your application by November 1 for Early Decision I admission

deadlines.name: Early Decision II
deadlines.says: by January 1 for Early Decision II

notifications.name: Early Decision I
notifications.says: Early decision candidates will be notified of the admission decision starting in the middle of December

notifications.name: Early Decision II
notifications.says: or after the middle of February for Early Decision II

notifications.name: Regular Decision
notifications.says: Regular decision candidates will receive notification on or around April 1.

not_read.what: NYU's own first-year admissions pages (the deadlines, the testing policy, the English tests)
not_read.got: an empty page each time: the site answers a program with a browser check (HTTP 302 to the same address with a challenge, then 202 with no text). Nothing is written from these pages.

not_read.what: The College of Arts and Science's bulletin page
not_read.got: read: it gives no date and sends the reader to the Undergraduate Admissions website.

sat_scores.label: SAT Suite Score Release Dates for Students and Educators
sat_scores.says: Most scores from weekend tests are released 2–4 weeks after test day.
